title: WALKWAY TUBE (10 m straight, between two door spot collars)
height: tube radius 1.6 m, axis 1.1 m above the deck: deck 2.3 m wide, glass band each side up to 2.7 m
notes: Numbers from the game (tube_way.gd radius 1.6, axis 1.1 m over the deck; link_tube.gd a hoop every 1.3 m, a 0.16 m collar each end; up to 20 m, at least 1 m straight before a bend, one bend at most).
